title: TAP: Tapping the Discriminative Potential of Frozen Representations for Class-Incremental Learning
title_zh: TAP：挖掘冻结表征在类增量学习中的判别潜力
abstract_en: Pre-trained models provide transferable representations for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, sequentially adapting these representations introduces optimization costs and may disrupt old-class feature structure. This motivates us to explore whether the discriminative potential of these representations can be further exploited by continually accumulating class information while keeping the encoders frozen. To this end, we propose TAP, a new and novel framework for tapping the discriminative potential of frozen representations in class-incremental learning. It accumulates visual and semantic class information in the frozen CLIP embedding space with only lightweight optimization. TAP comprises three modules: class-conditional visual distribution modeling, class-adaptive semantic calibration, and visual-semantic posterior fusion. The first module retains class means and within-class scatters, combining class-specific and shared covariances to stabilize distribution estimation. The second module learns class-specific weights over text templates from current-task images, adapting text representations to downstream classes. The third module combines the visual and semantic posteriors through a weighted product of experts for prediction over all seen classes without retaining images from previous tasks. Across nine datasets under two incremental protocols, TAP achieves state-of-the-art performance, attaining the highest average incremental and final-stage accuracies among the compared methods. The code is provided as an ancillary file.
abstract_zh: 预训练模型为类增量学习（CIL）提供了可迁移的表征，但随任务逐步调整表征不仅增加优化开销，还可能破坏旧类别的特征结构。为此，作者提出 TAP：冻结 CLIP 编码器，仅通过轻量级优化在其嵌入空间中持续积累各类别的视觉与语义信息。TAP 包含三个模块：类条件视觉分布建模保留类别均值和类内散布统计，并结合类别特定协方差与共享协方差，提高分布估计的稳定性；类别自适应语义校准利用当前任务的图像，为每个类别学习文本模板权重，使文本表征适应下游类别；视觉—语义后验融合通过加权专家乘积（product of experts）整合两种后验，无需保存以往任务的图像即可对所有已见类别进行预测。在九个数据集、两种增量协议下，TAP 在所比较的方法中取得了最高的平均增量准确率和最终阶段准确率。代码随论文附件提供。
key_points_zh: 冻结 CLIP 编码器，在固定嵌入空间中持续积累类别信息，避免逐任务更新编码器带来的开销与旧类特征结构变化。
保存类别均值和类内散布统计，结合类别特定协方差与共享协方差，稳定视觉分布估计。
利用当前任务图像为每个类别学习文本模板权重，再通过加权专家乘积融合视觉与语义后验，无需保存旧任务图像。
在九个数据集、两种增量协议的评估中，平均增量准确率和最终阶段准确率均居所比较方法之首。
